title: Count the steps — Savile Row to the Reform
learning_goal: Know that Fogg's 1,151 steps are close to the real kilometre and that Pall Mall is clubland lit by gas since 1807; feel the pace of a man who never hurries.

narration.script: Fogg leaves for his club at half past eleven, counting his steps. Five hundred and seventy-five with the right foot, five hundred and seventy-six with the left. One thousand one hundred and fifty-one. We'll count them with him; watch the counter in the corner. Look up the Row first, then turn to face numbers seven and eight. Today No. 7 is not the house Verne imagined — look for yourself. Now walk south. Sixty-seven steps, and here is Verne's corner: Savile Row, Burlington Gardens. Fogg turns right. Two hundred and eight. Old Bond Street — turn left, and downhill towards Piccadilly. Four hundred and five. Piccadilly. Cross over, step a few paces west, and turn down St James's Street. St James's Street, the long straight slope. Six hundred and twenty-nine, and Fogg has not hurried once. Keep going. Seven hundred and eighty-nine. This is Pall Mall, one of the first streets in London lit by gas, back in 1807. Sixty-five years before Fogg, the lamps here were already the future. Turn east; the clubs are on your right and the counter is climbing. Pall Mall is clubland. The Reform, the Travellers and the Athenaeum stand in a row, and one turn of the head covers all three. Stop. Face the Portland-stone palazzo with the tall windows: the Reform Club, 104 Pall Mall, by Charles Barry, opened in 1841. Turn a little left: 106, the Travellers, Barry's first palazzo, 1832. Beyond it, 107, the Athenaeum. And the counter reads one thousand one hundred and fifty-one. Fogg made it 1,151. We make it about a kilometre — eleven hundred metres between the corners. Close enough for a man who never hurries.

interaction.prompt: Walk with Fogg — the full 1,151 steps. Tap ahead to step; the counter climbs with you.

transition.music_cue: none — street ambience; gas-lamp cue (F-29) only if a lamp is in shot

production_notes: FULL SEVEN-STOP WALK (D5): route = M-39 → M-53 → M-54 → M-55 → M-56 → M-57 → M-37 façade, 1,120 m between OSM junction nodes (F-43). Route strings are lat,lng,heading (heading = initial view at the stop). Step counter: 1,151 steps / 1,120 m = 0.97 m per step (Fogg's implied stride); counter = round(cumulative metres × 1,151/1,120): stop 1 (65 m) 67 · stop 2 (202 m) 208 · stop 3 (394 m) 405 · mouth of St James's Street (448 m) 460 · stop 4 (≈ 612 m) 629 · stop 5 (768 m) 789 · stop 6 (1,120 m) 1,151. No jump, no fudge. The counter needs the Maps JavaScript API Street View service (position/pano-change events); the Embed API declared in the manifest cannot report position — API key / billing owner is open (D12); until then the walk plays as seven fixed panos and the counter steps per stop. Overlays and narration are waypoint-triggered: overlays[].at_waypoint = index into interaction.route; narration.waypoint_script[i] is spoken on arrival at route[i]; at_s and narration.script (= the join of waypoint_script) are the linear / no-JS fallback. Three pins share waypoint 6: fire them in at_s order, 15 s apart, from arrival. media[].fallback = manifest id shown if a pano is unavailable (M-33 for the Savile Row stops, M-20 for the façade); stops 2–5 have no still: skip to the next waypoint and add its steps. Sticker top-right so the lower third holds only one caption/pin at a time. Duration ~150 s at a steady tap; user-paced (90–240 s). Linear cut: this scene is replaced by 05 pall-mall-pass (M-01, 76 s). Narrator: waypoint_script is the source; regenerate script as its join.

Narration and overlays untouched. NOTE for the Scene Developer: interaction.prompt still says 'Tap ahead to step' — the walk now plays itself with no tapping, so that line needs a rewrite.
